title: ⚠️ 10 SIGNS A PREACHER IS OPERATING IN PRIDE, DECEPTION, AND CONTROL ⚠️
paragraphs: ⚠️ 10 SIGNS A PREACHER IS OPERATING IN PRIDE, DECEPTION, AND CONTROL ⚠️
Not every voice behind a pulpit is led by the Spirit of God.
Some are driven by something else.

And if you’re not discerning…
you can sit under it, submit to it, and slowly be shaped by it.
The Bible warns us clearly:
“For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” — 2 Corinthians 11:13

This is not about attacking people.
This is about protecting your soul.

Because deception doesn’t announce itself.
It disguises itself.
1. THEY PREACH THEMSELVES MORE THAN CHRIST

You hear their stories, their opinions, their authority…
but very little of Jesus.
“For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord.” — 2 Corinthians 4:5
If the spotlight never leaves the preacher… something is wrong.
2. THEY OPERATE IN PRIDE, NOT HUMILITY
They are unapproachable. Uncorrectable. Untouchable.
“God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” — James 4:6
True men and women of God tremble at His Word—not elevate themselves above others.
3. THEY TWIST SCRIPTURE TO CONTROL PEOPLE
They use verses out of context to manipulate obedience, money, or loyalty.
“Rightly dividing the word of truth.” — 2 Timothy 2:15

Truth sets people free.
Manipulation keeps them bound.
4. THEY CREATE DEPENDENCY ON THEMSELVES
Instead of pointing people to Christ, they make people rely on them.
“There is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.” — 1 Timothy 2:5
A true shepherd leads you to Jesus—not replaces Him.
5. THEY USE FEAR TO MAINTAIN CONTROL

“If you leave, you’ll be cursed.”
“If you question, you’re rebellious.”
That is not the voice of God.
“For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind.” — 2 Timothy 1:7
6. THEY REJECT CORRECTION
They don’t repent. They don’t apologize. They silence critics.
“Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge.” — Proverbs 12:1
A true servant of God remains teachable.
7. THEY LIVE A DOUBLE LIFE
Public holiness. Private compromise.
“Woe to you… hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs…” — Matthew 23:27

God is not impressed by performance.
He looks at the heart.
8. THEY SOW DIVISION, NOT UNITY
They subtly isolate people, divide leaders, and create factions.
“Mark those who cause divisions… and avoid them.” — Romans 16:17
Division is not from the Spirit of God.
9. THEY LACK GENUINE LOVE
They may sound powerful—but they don’t reflect Christ’s heart.
“If I… have not love, I am nothing.” — 1 Corinthians 13:2
Truth without love becomes harsh control.
10. THEY PREACH REPENTANCE BUT DON’T LIVE IT
They call others higher—but excuse their own sin.
“First remove the plank from your own eye…” — Matthew 7:5
⚠️ HERE IS THE REAL WARNING ⚠️
Jesus didn’t say, “You will know them by their gifts.”
He said:
“You will know them by their fruits.” — Matthew 7:16

Charisma is not fruit.
Anointing is not character.
Platform is not proof.
🔥 BUT THIS IS NOT JUST ABOUT THEM… THIS IS ABOUT YOU 🔥
Before pointing fingers, ask:

Am I walking in pride?
Do I resist correction?
Am I building my life on Christ—or people?
Because the same seeds can grow in us if we are not careful.
“Search me, O God, and know my heart…” — Psalm 139:23
🙏 PRAYER

Lord,
Give me discernment.
Protect me from deception.
Remove pride from my heart.
Make me humble, teachable, and rooted in Your truth.
Let my life reflect Jesus—not self.
In Jesus’ name, Amen.

This is not about fear.
This is about truth.
And truth sets you free. 🔥
